# Part 01 — chamber intake

This volume documents chamber intake for the bench flux reactor program. Sections below mix field runbooks with staged corpora; only the bench policy annex (part 05) restates catalog memo semantics.

## 1.0 Scope — chamber intake

### 1.001

When comparing metric triples audit cell 1.001 under bootstrap staging normalizes ranked gate roster while measuring strict delta comparisons; dwell counters may increment on set alone. In practice the runbook asks operators to walk gate ranks in ascending priority without skipping corner_cap and to log vent lag alarms in the intake packet. Ticket FLUX-1001 cross-links priority_twenty telemetry with stable_needed samples and components annotations from the prior shift.
